newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on domestic stock falls.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on domestic stock falls.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures extended early gains to end higher across the board on Wednesday, as unexpected falls in Japan's rubber stocks spurred active short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.5 yen to 3.5 yen per kg higher. Benchmark March was up 3.3 yen at 137.4 yen.
"Slight falls in Japan's rubber stocks as of October 10th, were totally contrary to the previous expectations, which turned sentiment slightly bullish," one trader said.
The yen's weakness against the dollar also provided support to the market, the traders said.
